name: brief-transcript-only
description: The last meeting has a transcript and typed notes but no action plan: no open items to list, and the model must stay with what was said.

notes.title: Offsite chat
notes.content: Two venues shortlisted. Budget is the question.
transcript: you: Thanks for jumping on. Where are we with the offsite venues?
them: I have two options, the lakeside hotel and the old mill. The mill is cheaper but has no breakout rooms.
you: Can you send me both quotes by Thursday so I can check them against the budget?
them: Sure, I'll send both quotes by Thursday.
you: Great. I'll ask the team which dates in June work for them.
them: Perfect, then we can decide at the next planning call.
